title: Shared by every object
description:
Write a class `Monster` that knows how many monsters exist.

- A `static` member variable holds the count. It belongs to the class, so there is one copy however many monsters there are.
- Every constructor adds one (including the **copy** constructor: a copy is a new monster too). The destructor subtracts one.
- `static int alive()` returns the count. It is called on the class: `Monster::alive()`.
